PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'changed=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "*.java" "*.ts" "*.tsx" 2>/dev/null; git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(java|ts|tsx)$"); printf "%s\n" "$changed" | sort -u | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *api.ts|*generated*) continue;; esac; if ! grep -qE "/\*\*|^//|/\*[^*]" "$f"; then echo "DOC_WARNING: $f has no documentation comments"; fi; done; exit 0'
